selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data under /srv/inventory is preserved (owner/group/content unchanged in substance)
selected_evidence.summary: Initial listing showed root-owned files with world-readable content; after chown/chmod the same records.csv and config.json content was printed unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc, group set to inventory-readers
selected_evidence.summary: ls -ld output shows all files/dirs under /srv/inventory owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers.

selected_evidence.requirement: Readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
selected_evidence.summary: A test user added to inventory-readers could cat records.csv; a test user outside the group got Permission denied. Mode 750/640 confirmed with no rwx bits for others. Test users were removed afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a plus confirmed permissions and data readability by inventorysvc before reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot was backgrounded with nohup; the exec call returned 'reboot command issued' successfully before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: proof node actually went down and came back with changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node offline mid-reboot); second poll returned boot_id 997b9f75-c2ff-4cde-8abd-5c44b3b2b0e9, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: post-restart recovery of required state
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group still exist, /srv/inventory retains 750/640 ownership and permissions, and both data files are intact and readable by inventorysvc.
